title: Input contract: a labelled file input plus a drop-zone plus a keyboard alternative per WCAG 2.5.7
description: The upload surface renders a labelled native file input, a labelled drop-zone region for pointer users, and a keyboard-focusable alternative control that opens the picker on Enter or Space. Every input carries an accessible name via label association or aria-label. The three affordances share the same underlying file collector so a keyboard-only user, a pointer user with drag-drop and a screen-reader user reach the same state. Per WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements, the drop-zone is never the only way to add a file; a click and keyboard path both satisfy the same acceptance criterion.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.2, REQ 1.
